_comment: Four accents x two genders. Keys are <accent>_<gender>; the API also accepts an accent name plus a separate gender parameter. Maya1 voices are described in words; the cloned ones point at a real speaker of that gender, which is why gender is a different reference clip rather than a pitch knob.

indian_male.label: Indian man speaking English
indian_male.description: Realistic male voice in his 30s, an Indian immigrant with an Indian accent speaking English. Normal pitch, warm timbre, conversational pacing.

indian_female.label: Indian woman speaking English
indian_female.description: Realistic female voice in her 30s, an Indian immigrant woman with an Indian accent speaking English. Normal pitch, warm timbre, conversational pacing.

american_male.label: American man
american_male.description: Realistic male voice in his 30s with a General American accent, a native English speaker. Normal pitch, warm timbre, conversational pacing.

american_female.label: American woman
american_female.description: Realistic female voice in her 30s with a General American accent, a native English speaker. Normal pitch, warm timbre, conversational pacing.
